svg.aria-label: How colcon buildx works with an OEROS image: OEROS publishes a stack of images; colcon buildx adds one layer of what the SDK image lacks, builds your workspace in it on your own architecture, and copies the result to the robot, which runs the same stack.
svg.text: CROSS SDK · FROM SCRATCH, NO USERLAND
Each image is a layer on the one below.
a shell, if the image has none
the SDK environment, if not set
the same stack runs on the robot
